description: Extension of CronJobEditor providing helper methods for UI rendering, data hydration, payload building, validation, and schedule parsing in a macOS application.

classes.name: CronJobEditor
classes.description: A class responsible for editing cron jobs within the application, extended here with helper functions.

methods.name: gridLabel
methods.description: Creates a styled label view for the UI.

methods.name: hydrateFromJob
methods.description: Populates the editor's fields from a given job object.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Builds payload and triggers save callback, handling errors.

methods.name: buildPayload
methods.description: Constructs a dictionary representing the cron job payload for saving.

methods.name: buildDelivery
methods.description: Builds delivery options for the payload.

methods.name: trimmed
methods.description: Trims whitespace characters from a string.

methods.name: requireName
methods.description: Validates that the name field is not empty.

methods.name: buildSchedule
methods.description: Constructs schedule data based on user input.

methods.name: buildSelectedPayload
methods.description: Builds payload based on selected payload type.

methods.name: validateSessionTarget
methods.description: Validates session target consistency with payload.

methods.name: validatePayloadRequiredFields
methods.description: Ensures required fields are filled based on payload type.

methods.name: applyDeleteAfterRun
methods.description: Sets delete after run flag in payload.

methods.name: buildAgentTurnPayload
methods.description: Creates payload for agent turn type.

methods.name: effectiveSessionTargetRaw
methods.description: Returns the effective session target string, considering preserved value.

methods.name: isIsolatedLikeSessionTarget
methods.description: Checks if session target is isolated or similar.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Formats duration in milliseconds into a concise string.
